safety_verdicts.content: Headache improves when the patient is lying down.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not document that the headache improves when lying down.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether a headache improves when lying down is a clinically relevant positional feature that can help distinguish primary headache from secondary causes (e.g., intracranial hypotension/CSF leak) and can influence escalation decisions. Omitting it can reduce diagnostic accuracy and delay appropriate follow-up if the headache is orthostatic.
